THE ECHO BELOW · SCENE
Area 3 · Kennel and wolves
Change prepared scene
Say aloud

A sharp animal smell cuts through the damp cave air. Chains scrape against stone. Three pairs of eyes turn toward you from the dark, and low growls fill the cramped chamber.

The scrape of the chains marks the animals' movements more clearly than the dim light does. There is little room to spread out here, and the growling rises when attention turns toward them. You can stop at the edge of the chamber before choosing how to approach.

Ask the players

“Do you approach, offer food, try to calm them, or keep your distance?”
